data.long_meaning: There is no significant cultural, biblical, or historical meaning associated with the name Giffy. The name Giffy carries the meaning “Short and quick” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Giffy usually hope their child will grow to embody short and quick and live with faith, good character and purpose.
